adjudication.rationale: Yes. In `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, the object keys are computed with `z.string().toString()` and `z.string().optional().toString()`. Those expressions are evaluated immediately when building the object literal, and both are just strings, not “wildcard” keys. In practice they will evaluate to the same literal (typically `"[object Object]"`), so the latter property overwrites the former. As a result, the schema does not implement the intended “any numeric expiry field / allow other properties” behavior and instead defines (at most) a single oddly-named field.
